The Max Planck Institute for Demographic Research (MPIDR) is seeking to appoint a full-time postdoctoral researcher to join the Max Planck Research Group on Medical Demography, led by Marcus Ebeling.

We invite applications from candidates who have, or will soon obtain, a PhD in demography, epidemiology, medicine, public health, sociology, health economics, biostatistics, or a related field. We welcome applications from candidates whose profile closely aligns with the group's existing research directions, as well as from those whose disciplinary background, methodological training, or empirical focus would extend the range of expertise within the group. As a growing group, we value both continuity with our current work and the addition of complementary perspectives.
